Skills.Name: Create Architecture
Skills.Description: Help the operator design a reusable DevCraft architecture through a focused back-and-forth conversation, then produce a completed architecture document from the architecture template.

Skills.Name: Create Project Type
Skills.Description: Help the operator design a reusable DevCraft project type through a focused back-and-forth conversation, then produce a completed project type document from the project type template.

Skills.Name: Create Skill
Skills.Description: Help the operator design a reusable DevCraft skill through a focused back-and-forth conversation, then produce a completed skill document from the skill template.

Skills.Name: Create Standard
Skills.Description: Help the operator design a reusable DevCraft standard through a focused back-and-forth conversation, then produce a completed standard document from the standard template.

Skills.Name: DevCraft Import
Skills.Description: Import reusable DevCraft documentation from a local documentation repository into the profile-level DevCraft folder, then update the profile catalog in `configure.json`.

Skills.Name: DevCraft Discovery Questions
Skills.Description: Drive clear operator decisions during both project-level DevCraft discovery and feature-level DevCraft discovery or clarification. Present every material decision as a fully written numbered question, followed by explanatory context and lettered options in the operator's required format.

Skills.Name: Discovery Gap Analyzer
Skills.Description: Find and resolve weaknesses in DevCraft feature documentation before implementation by comparing the active feature artifacts, recording issues in `analysis.md`, and presenting all known issues together for compact batch resolution.

Skills.Name: GitHub Issue Feature Intake
Skills.Description: Create an evidence-backed DevCraft feature dossier, initial `spec.md`, and initial feature discovery from a GitHub issue while preserving operator-controlled state transitions.

Skills.Name: Operator Questions
Skills.Description: Present material questions to the operator of a project or feature in a consistent, decision-ready format outside formal DevCraft discovery and clarification sessions.

Templates.Name: architecture template
Templates.Description: One sentence: what this architecture enables and when DevCraft should use it.

Templates.Name: project type template
Templates.Description: Use this template to define a type of project that DevCraft can be used to create.

Templates.Name: skill template
Templates.Description: One sentence: what this skill enables.

Templates.Name: standard template
Templates.Description: One sentence: what this standard governs and when DevCraft should apply it.

FeatureStorageTypes.Name: ado work item
FeatureStorageTypes.Description: Use this feature storage mode when DevCraft feature artifacts should live on an Azure DevOps work item instead of inside the project repository.

FeatureStorageTypes.Name: github issue
FeatureStorageTypes.Description: Use this feature storage mode when DevCraft feature artifacts should live on a GitHub issue instead of inside the project repository.

FeatureStorageTypes.Name: jira work item
FeatureStorageTypes.Description: Use this feature storage mode when DevCraft feature artifacts should live on a JIRA issue instead of inside the project repository.

FeatureStorageTypes.Name: repo central
FeatureStorageTypes.Description: Store DevCraft feature artifacts inside the repository DevCraft folder. This is the current local-repository behavior.

FeatureStorageTypes.Name: system central
FeatureStorageTypes.Description: Store DevCraft feature artifacts in the profile DevCraft folder so multiple repositories can be tracked from one central system-level feature store.

Scan.Description: Run Codex in non-interactive JSON mode for DevCraft folder scanning.

Session.Description: Open an interactive Codex session that the operator can take over.

Scan.Description: Run Claude Code in print mode for DevCraft folder scanning.

Session.Description: Open an interactive Claude Code session that the operator can take over.

SupportedClients.Name: GitHub Copilot
SupportedClients.Description: GitHub Copilot terminal integration through the GitHub CLI.

Scan.Description: Run GitHub Copilot through the GitHub CLI for DevCraft folder scanning.

Session.Description: Open a GitHub Copilot CLI interaction that the operator can take over.
